prisoner.name: Prudencia Masancay
prisoner.description: Prudencia Masancay was held by US military authorities at Balayan, Batangas, during the Philippine-American War. The Army register classified this detainee as a suspected insurgent. The record documents several weeks of confinement followed by release.

cases.charges: US military detention for alleged insurgency; no criminal conviction established
cases.sentence: Released by the commanding officer after an oath, at the request and responsibility of the president of Balayan. The corrected surname above the crossed-out form is used. No individual criminal sentence established for this period.

case_research.custody_evidence: Original military register page 2, row 5 identifies the detainee, date of capture and dated release; the interval establishes actual multi-day US-authority confinement.

entries.custody_evidence: Original military register page 2, row 5 identifies the detainee, date of capture and dated release; the interval establishes actual multi-day US-authority confinement.
entries.status_research: Historical custody verified. Existing profiles, cases and photos are preserved. No unsupported vital dates, coordinates, current incarceration, institutional relation or personal support website inferred. Custody occurred under US colonial military authority in the Philippines. The captor’s insurgency classification is attributed, not accepted as a finding of guilt. The affiliation denotes war context, not proven Katipunan membership. No birthday is calculated from the recorded age. Gender, death date, portrait, modern prison ID, exact building coordinates and personal support website remain unverified. Extra match-name variants are conservative handwriting/transcription search keys, not claimed legal names or verified aliases, and are not displayed as aka values.
